desc: Derive the exact Boolean/XOR constraints for Type-A and Type-B tile orientations.
Verify that each feasible local boundary-edge assignment uniquely determines a tile orientation.
Reduce the global condition to a sparse XOR constraint graph on \(2HW\) toroidal edge variables.
Implement and validate a near-linear parity DSU, including H=2/W=2 toroidal edge indexing and contradiction detection.
Count DSU connected components and produce the required modular power-of-two answer.
